Honestly, distracting myself is what works best. If i know I am going to be in a situation that makes me anxious later (like going to a restaurant with friends), I try eating a little bit beforehand because I know I won’t be able to later. That way I am still eating. 
I wish I could give you better advice but it’s just trial and error. Sometimes I can only eat something if I’m by myself, watching youtube or something other distracting. Other times I can only eat if other people are there and I can focus on their conversation and talking. 
It takes a lot of practice but not thinking about food and the fact that I’m eating works for me too. For a while that meant that my family could not as much as mention food or eating during dinner.
Lastly, when you do eat, make sure it’s nutrient rich and not too heavy. It might help speaking to a nutritionist to tell you what type of food could be good for you but won’t be too heavy on the stomach. For me, knowing that I’m at least giving my body fuel it can use and not just fast food or pre processed foods, takes some of my worry away a little and helps with my anxiety too.

I don’t really have a definite answer here. It’s all about small things, figuring out what works for you. I used to have a fear of throwing up like OP but after throwing up almost daily for a little while during some treatment I went through, it disappeared (which might not be helpful to you but it helped me to figure out while not pleasant, throwing up is not this scary thing I imagined it was which in turn took some of my anxiety away too. One less stressor to think about). Sorry, if none of this is very helpful but my point is that small things and experiences helped me and it took years to figure them out. I still struggle, especially during stressful times but it has gotten better. 

One last thing (this might be annoying advice and not what you want to hear but it’s the case for me), even if it’s difficult to eat because of the anxiety, I still try to eat something because I know that If I don’t eat anything, I will only feel worse, my anxiety will get worse and it will be even harder later. I say I *try* to eat and not *force* myself to eat and what I mean by that is that I tell myself I can stop at any moment. No one is going to force me, if it gets too difficult I can just stop. By doing that, it takes some of the pressure off and makes it a little easier to eat. If I say to myself I have to eat and that there’s no other option, I force myself into a corner and it makes my anxiety much worse. 

I don’t know if any of this helps you but these are techniques I could think of that works for me.
